description:
Fletcher Membrane Tapes and Thermal Break Accessories comprise
high-performance sealing tapes and thermal break materials designed to
complement Fletcher's Sisalation, Vapawrap, and glasswool insulation systems.
Tapes like Vapastop 883 and VapaSeam are engineered from reinforced aluminum
foil or technical acrylic polymers to provide durable vapor-tight and air-tight
seams. Thermal break accessories ensure continuous thermal isolation over steel
and timber framing members in compliance with NCC energy efficiency
provisions.
features:
Reinforced aluminum foil backing for high tensile
strength
Aggressive cold-weather acrylic and synthetic rubber adhesives
Vapor-tight seal preventing moisture migration across membrane laps

Airtight
barrier improving blower-door building tightness

Tested for low flammability
to AS 1530.2

Hand-tearable and easy-release liners for fast jobsite
installation

Compatible with Sisalation reflective foils, Vapawrap, and HVAC
duct wrap
Resistant to UV degradation and temperature extremes
compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC
Volume One and Two
sustainability:
Low VOC emissions; zero ozone-depleting
potential (ODP)
install:
Ensure substrate and membrane surfaces are dry,
clean, and free from dust, oil, and frost

Overlap building membrane sheets by
a minimum of 150mm (or 50mm if fully taped)

Center tape squarely over the
overlapping seam or penetration interface

Press tape firmly down along the
entire length using a plastic squeegee or roller

Ensure all air bubbles and
wrinkles are completely smoothed out

Do not overstretch tape during
application to avoid tension wrinkles
selection_checklist:
Confirm
membrane type (use Vapastop 883 for reflective foils; VapaSeam for breathable
wraps)
Select width (48mm standard, 72mm for roofs and wide gaps)
Calculate total lineal meters required for laps and penetrations

Verify
application temperature exceeds +5°C
limitations:
Pressure-sensitive adhesive
requires firm squeegee pressure for permanent bond

Must not be applied to
wet, oily, or frozen surfaces

Not intended for structural load-bearing
applications
warranty: Backed by Fletcher Insulation product warranty
use_cases:
Sealing overlaps on Sisalation reflective foil sarking in roof
and wall cavities

Joining Permastop building blanket foil laps for
condensation control

Sealing HVAC sheet metal duct wrap seams and
penetrations
rag_summary:
Fletcher Membrane Tapes and Thermal Break
Accessories provide engineered sealing solutions including Vapastop 883
reinforced aluminum foil tape and Sisalation VapaSeam tape. Built with high-grab
pressure-sensitive adhesives and tear-resistant backings, they form airtight and
vapor-tight seals across building membranes, reflective foils, and duct wrap.
Rated with a low Flammability Index (≤ 5 to AS 1530.2), they are essential
components for achieving NCC-compliant energy efficiency, condensation control,
and air barrier integrity.

use_cases:
Legacy
acoustic friction-fit infill in commercial metal stud walls

Sound
transmission dampening in multi-residential party wall cavities

Acoustic
floor-to-floor decoupling in timber and concrete intermediate floors
rag_summary:
Fletcher
Safe'n'Silent Pro350 represents a legacy high-density stonewool/mineral wool
acoustic batt line formerly distributed by Fletcher Insulation for commercial
drywall partitions and party walls. Engineered for high acoustic sound
transmission loss (Rw) and non-combustible fire protection, it has been
superseded in Fletcher's contemporary Australian catalog by Soundbreak
high-density glasswool and Fletcher Protect Stonewool products. It solved
airborne sound transfer and inter-tenancy noise leakage in commercial and
multi-residential partition assemblies.

problem_keywords:
tearing foil facing on
insulation batts
use_cases: Factory or site lamination to glasswool blankets for roof and wall insulation
Heavy-duty vapor barrier facing in industrial metal building applications
Radiant heat reflection over metal purlins and wall framing
not_for:
Cold
climate non-drained cavity walls requiring Class 4 breathable wraps
rag_summary:
Fletcher Sisalation FF HD (Foil Facing Heavy Duty) represents a
legacy industrial reinforced aluminum foil facing laminate formerly manufactured
by Fletcher Insulation for laminating to bulk glasswool blankets. Featuring high
tensile fiberglass scrim and kraft reinforcement, it provided heavy-duty tear
resistance and an impermeable Class 1 vapor barrier reflecting up to 95% of
radiant heat. Today, this specification is integrated into pre-laminated product
lines like Permastop Building Blanket Heavy Duty and Sisalation Multipurpose
EHD.

description:
Foilboard Accessories comprise specialized installation hardware
and sealing components engineered to ensure complete thermal envelope continuity
and mechanical stability for Foilboard insulation panels. The range includes
aluminum foil joiner tapes, blanking plates, Floor Saddles, and Flexifast nylon
fasteners designed specifically to eliminate thermal bridging and maintain
non-destructive airspaces. These accessories ensure wall, ceiling, and
underfloor installations achieve rated system R-values and meet Australian
building compliance.
features:
Engineered specifically for Foilboard
rigid insulation panel systems

Eliminates thermal bridging at panel junctions
and framing fasteners

Reinforced aluminum foil tape creates continuous vapor
and air barrier

Durable, corrosion-resistant polymer and galvanized steel
components

Designed for fast installation in residential, commercial, and
underfloor applications

Prevents panel sagging and dislocation over the life
of the building

Tested for compatibility with EPS core and pure aluminum
facings
fire:
Foil tape tested to AS 1530.2 Flammability
Index ≤ 5; Components compliant with NCC fire hazard requirements
sustainability: 100% recyclable components; low VOC; zero ODP
install:
Position panels with
required 20mm+ air space to substrate

Fix panels mechanically using Flexifast
pins or Floor Saddles at maximum 600mm centers

Tape all panel butt joins,
corners, and penetrations with Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape

Firmly
squeegee tape to ensure permanent pressure-sensitive adhesion and airtight seal
selection_checklist:
Confirm Foilboard panel thickness to match
fastener/saddle length

Determine joist spacing (450mm vs 600mm) for saddle
quantities

Calculate total linear meters of panel joints for tape
requirements

Ensure substrate allows mechanical fixing of Flexifast pins or
screws
limitations:
Tape must be applied to clean, dry,
and dust-free surfaces

Do not substitute non-approved duct tapes that degrade
under heat

Saddles and fasteners are non-structural; do not support
mechanical equipment
warranty:
Covered under Foilboard 25-year
performance warranty system
use_cases: Securing Foilboard panels between timber floor joists using Floor Saddles

Sealing panel joins with 72mm reinforced aluminum tape to form a continuous
vapor barrier

Direct-pinning Foilboard to masonry or concrete basement walls
with Flexifast anchors
rag_summary:
Foilboard Accessories include 72mm reinforced aluminum foil
sealing tape, galvanized Floor Saddles, Flexifast polymer fasteners, and blank
plates purpose-designed for Foilboard insulation panels. They eliminate thermal
bridging, maintain designed reflective airspaces, and mechanically anchor panels
across underfloor joists, concrete slabs, and framed walls. Tested for thermal
and fire compliance, they ensure Foilboard installations achieve their rated
Total R-value and maintain long-term structural resilience.

description:
Foilboard Blank Plates are lightweight, rigid spreading washers
designed to distribute screw and fastener loads over Foilboard rigid insulation
boards without crushing the expanded polystyrene (EPS) core. Manufactured from
high-impact polymer or sheet metal, they feature pre-punched center holes that
accommodate standard wood screws, self-drilling metal tek screws, or masonry
anchors. By creating a broad clamping surface, they prevent fastener heads from
pulling through the aluminum foil facing during wind load or structural
vibration.
features:
Distributes fastening pressure over a broad surface
area to prevent panel crushing

Stops screw heads from tearing through the
outer aluminum foil laminate

Pre-punched center hole to fit standard screws,
nails, and anchors

Constructed from durable, corrosion-resistant, high-impact
polymer or metal

Lightweight, rigid, and fast to position during
installation

Compatible with all Foilboard panel thicknesses from 10mm
to 50mm
Ideal for walls, ceilings, and underfloor applications
fire:
Non-combustible metal or low-hazard polymer;
compatible with NCC fire compliance systems
compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1,
AS 3999, NCC Volume One and Two
install:
Position Foilboard panel in place against framing or
masonry substrate

Insert screw, nail, or anchor through the center hole of
the Foilboard Blank Plate

Drive fastener through the Foilboard panel into
timber, steel, or masonry framing

Tighten until the Blank Plate rests snug
and flat against the aluminum foil facing

Do not over-torque to avoid
compressing the underlying EPS core

Place Blank Plates at recommended spacing
(typically 600mm centers along edges and center)

Cover plate and fastener
head with Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape if an airtight vapor seal is
required
selection_checklist:
Confirm fastener screw length
accommodates panel thickness plus substrate embedment

Calculate quantity
needed based on approx. 6-8 plates per 2440x1200mm board

Choose polymer or
galvanized plate based on substrate and environmental exposure

Order
matching 72mm foil tape to seal over screw heads
limitations:
Do not over-tighten fasteners as excessive torque
will deform the panel core

Blank Plates do not provide thermal break values
on their own

Not designed to support heavy structural cladding loads
independently
use_cases:
Securing
Foilboard panels to timber or steel wall studs without crushing the EPS core
Fixing Foilboard sheets to garage ceilings or shed framing using tek screws
Spreading mechanical clamping force when fastening Foilboard to masonry walls
rag_summary:
Foilboard
Blank Plates are rigid 40mm x 40mm spreader plates engineered to distribute
fastening loads when securing Foilboard insulation boards to timber, steel, or
masonry framing. Pre-punched to accept standard construction screws and nails,
they prevent fasteners from crushing the EPS core or tearing through the
reflective aluminum facing. They ensure solid mechanical fixing across wall,
ceiling, and underfloor applications without compromising panel integrity.

description:
Foilboard Green is a rigid, Australian-manufactured insulation
panel constructed from a fire-retardant expanded polystyrene (EPS) core
laminated on both sides with pure aluminum foil facings. Engineered for use in
roofs, external and internal walls, retrofits, and suspended underfloor
applications, it provides a 3-in-1 thermal insulation, thermal break, and
moisture barrier. Available in ratings from R1.6 to R4.0 across 10mm to 50mm
thicknesses, it achieves high Total R-values when paired with adjacent
reflective airspaces.
features:
3-in-1 insulation, thermal break, and
moisture barrier in a single rigid panel

Fire-retardant expanded polystyrene
(EPS) core with pure aluminum foil facings

Pure aluminum reflective facings
reflect up to 97% of radiant heat

Achieves system Total R-values up to R4.0+
in conjunction with adjacent airspaces

Zero harmful fibers; non-allergenic
and non-carcinogenic with no itch

Extremely lightweight, rigid, and fast to
cut and install on site

Impermeable to moisture and will not sag, rot, or
deteriorate over time

Anti-glare coating on one face for safe installation in
bright sunlight

Group 1 fire hazard rating compliant with AS 5637.1 / AS
ISO 9705 for ceilings/walls

Backed by an Australian 25-year performance
warranty

rag_summary:
Foilboard Green is a rigid Australian-made
insulation board composed of a fire-retardant EPS core laminated with pure
aluminum foil facings on both sides. Available in thicknesses from 10mm to 50mm
(Total R-values from R1.6 to R4.0+ when paired with airspaces), it acts as a
combined thermal insulator, thermal break, and vapor barrier across walls,
roofs, sheds, and suspended timber floors. Fiber-free, moisture-impermeable,
non-allergenic, and tested to Group 1 fire standards, it delivers lifetime
thermal efficiency backed by a 25-year performance warranty.

description:
Foilboard DIY / Fast Trade Pack (Foilboard Handypack) is a
convenient, compact-format pack of rigid Foilboard Green insulation sheets
designed for smaller residential projects, shed retrofits, and tight-access
installations. Each pack contains pre-cut sheets that fit easily inside standard
vehicles, allowing DIYers and trades to transport and handle panels without a
commercial truck. Fabricated from the same fire-retardant EPS core with pure
aluminum foil facings, it delivers superior radiant heat reflection and thermal
barrier performance.
features:
Compact pack format designed to fit easily
into passenger vehicles, vans, and utes

Pre-cut sheet sizes for effortless
handling through tight doorways and crawl spaces

Manufactured with
fire-retardant EPS core and pure aluminum reflective facings

Delivers
true 3-in-1 thermal insulation, thermal break, and vapor barrier

Zero itchy
fibers; completely safe to handle without protective clothing

Waterproof and
moisture resistant, will not rot or grow mold

Cuts cleanly with a utility
knife with zero toxic dust

Backed by Foilboard's 25-year performance
warranty

Lining hobby sheds and workshop walls without hiring commercial transport
Quick DIY thermal upgrades behind washing machines and kitchen joinery
rag_summary:
Foilboard DIY / Fast Trade Pack (Foilboard Handypack) is a modular, pre-cut
pack of Foilboard Green rigid insulation sheets (1200mm x 600mm) sized
specifically for car boot transport and tight jobsite access. Featuring the same
fire-retardant EPS core with dual pure aluminum reflective facings as full-sized
boards, it provides an itch-free, moisture-proof thermal and vapor barrier for
smaller renovations, subfloors, and sheds. Available in 15mm, 20mm, and 25mm
thicknesses, it delivers premium thermal performance backed by a 25-year
warranty.

description:
Foilboard Flexifast Fasteners are specialized one-piece nylon
anchor fasteners engineered to secure Foilboard rigid insulation panels directly
to masonry, brickwork, concrete tilt-up slabs, and timber substrates. Featuring
a large, flexible clamping head integrated with an expanding ribbed shank,
Flexifast anchors eliminate thermal bridging while firmly holding panels without
tearing through the aluminum foil facing. They provide an efficient, hammer-in
or push-in fixing solution for residential basement walls, commercial carpark
soffits, and precast facades.
features:
One-piece non-conductive nylon
construction eliminates thermal bridging

Broad flexible head clamps panels
firmly without puncturing the aluminum facing

Expanding barbed anchor shank
locks tightly into pre-drilled masonry or concrete

Durable, UV-stabilized,
and non-corrosive in damp environments

Fast push-in or hammer-in installation
into 8mm pre-drilled holes

Available in multiple lengths (45mm, 70mm, 95mm)
to suit 10mm to 50mm panels

High pull-out resistance to withstand wind
suction and panel weight

Ideal for precast concrete, brick, blockwork, and
timber

Tap gently with a hammer or

Tape over fastener heads with Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape if an

rag_summary:
Foilboard Flexifast Fasteners are
one-piece non-conductive nylon anchors engineered to secure Foilboard panels
directly to masonry, concrete, and timber substrates. Featuring a 35-45mm wide
flexible washer head and an 8mm barbed expanding anchor shank, they clamp panels
tightly without puncturing the aluminum facing or creating thermal bridging.
Available in 45mm, 70mm, and 95mm lengths to suit 10mm to 50mm boards, they
provide rapid, hammer-in fixing for basement walls, carpark soffits, and precast
concrete panels.

description:
Foilboard Floor Saddles are specialized galvanized steel support
brackets engineered specifically for installing Foilboard rigid insulation
boards between timber floor joists. Designed with pre-set drops, they
automatically create and maintain the required 20mm+ still reflective airspace
between the insulation panel and the underside of floorboards. Suitable for new
suspended floor construction or retrofits from above, they hold Foilboard panels
securely in place without compression, preventing sagging over the life of the
building.
features:
Engineered specifically for suspending Foilboard
panels between timber floor joists

Pre-set drop automatically establishes the
critical 20mm reflective airspace

Constructed from durable galvanized spring
steel to resist corrosion

Simple hammer-on or press-fit installation onto
timber joists

Available in sizes to accommodate 10-25mm and 20-50mm board
thicknesses

Maintains permanent panel position, preventing sagging or
dislocation

Eliminates the need for adhesives or complicated underfloor
strapping
Accelerates installation from above before laying floorboards

Measure timber floor joist spacing

Install tongue-and-groove flooring or

rag_summary:
Foilboard Floor Saddles are
galvanized spring-steel support brackets designed to cradle Foilboard panels
between timber joists in new suspended floor construction. Engineered in 100mm
and 130mm depths to accommodate panels from 10mm to 50mm, they automatically
guarantee the critical 20mm reflective airspace required beneath floorboards to
achieve rated underfloor R-values. Installed from above before flooring is laid,
they hold panels permanently in place without sagging, eliminating the need for
strapping or adhesives.

description:
The Foilboard Garage Door Kit is an all-in-one DIY thermal
insulation system engineered specifically for residential sectional and
panel-lift metal garage doors. Containing pre-cut lightweight Foilboard panels,
specialized mounting hardware, and aluminum foil tape, the kit reflects radiant
heat and stops thermal transfer into the garage. By insulating uninsulated metal
garage doors, it lowers garage temperatures by up to 10°C in summer, reduces
winter chill, and operates quietly without adding significant weight to door
spring mechanisms.

Complete all-in-one DIY kit to insulate a
standard sectional garage door

Can reduce garage ambient temperature by up

Ultra-lightweight design does not strain automatic garage

Pre-cut panels sized to fit standard panel-lift

Acts as an acoustic buffer, reducing external street noise and

Backed by Foilboard's 25-year performance warranty

rag_summary:
The
Foilboard Garage Door Kit is an all-in-one DIY insulation system designed to
insulate residential sectional panel-lift metal garage doors. Comprising
lightweight, pre-cut Foilboard Green panels (10mm or 15mm), heavy-duty mounting
fasteners, and reinforced aluminum tape, it reflects up to 97% of radiant heat
to lower garage temperatures by up to 10°C in summer. Adding only 4-6 kg to the
entire door, it preserves automatic door opener balance while providing thermal,
acoustic, and anti-vibration benefits backed by a 25-year warranty.
